review_type: Separate creator self-critique followed by independent Blender asset inspection
selected_defects: tube openings buried by steep terrain
source_cause: Original placement sampled only the cluster origin before terrain refinement; this ignored the separate tube base footprints. Open-surface normal recalculation did not guarantee upward sand winding.
source_repair: Finish terrain before placement; raycast exact final terrain without a z=0 clamp.
Use fixed, reviewed local offsets/yaws; seat each tube cluster from its weakest-supported base with 3mm embedding and assert lip clearance >=45mm.
Move one bush and one kelp to remove remaining surface crossings.

requirement_ledger.finding: Single 1.65m peak and broad base preserved; actual rock geometry unchanged. Highest coral 1.394m remains 0.256m below summit.
Diver, fish and rock proportions unchanged. Two tube clusters moved onto upper ledges; others repositioned locally for fit, without new peaks.
Distinct warm corals, blue facets and green kelp remain readable under the same three-light Eevee setup.
All 91 mesh objects retained; coral families, kelp, fish and diver equipment visible.
171 sampled component bases have contact; no wholly unsupported tube base remains. Tube lips clear final terrain by at least 0.045m.
Open sand mesh explicitly wound upward; no inconsistent manifold winding or inward closed component detected.
11 baseline decoration-pair surface overlaps reduced to zero. Intentional rooted terrain embedding and assembled diver joints are excluded from decoration-pair testing.
49420 scene triangles, 16690 unique, 26 shared/unique meshes, 1 packed atlas/material; names, parents, non-decoration transforms and non-sand geometry/UVs preserved.

bounds_note: Aggregate X/Y and upper Z bounds unchanged; shallow below-sand root embedding lowers the lower Z bound by about 5.1mm, within the recorded 1cm tolerance.
tool_limit: Optional Rust quality_report/compare_scenes runtime is not built. Used Blender inspector plus source-owned read-only mesh, BVH contact and snapshot regression audits; no runtime installation required.
evidence_limits: Visual review uses the single supplied concept; rear surfaces are inferred, not matched to calibrated reference views.
Root sampling and pairwise decoration BVH overlap are bounded checks, not a mathematical proof against every self-intersection.
Production GLB export, fresh import and Three.js validation remain Step 06–07.
